text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Hm hmm... woo! ♪ Yeah, yeah, this really 
is such a great song!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Gotta say, I was surprised. I never 
expected that for a birthday present—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
To think Shakur would recommend music to 
me! And it's perfect for tap dancing, too! 
You found some great stuff♪

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... It looks like they were overjoyed. 
...That's a relief, isn't it, Shakur-san?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Looks like something fun happened, 
huh? Tell me all about it, Messiah!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ah... um, I happened to see it. Shakur-san 
was compiling data titled 
"For_Tap_0316"...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Tap-senpai's birthday date, and her 
name... I thought it had something to do 
with a celebration, so when I asked... she 
said yes...?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, why're you tilting your head like 
that?! Well, I get that it's "unlike me", 
though!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Makes sense. That's just a draft 
tracklist I made for tap dancing. The 
numbers were just a coincidence... I 
didn't even notice until Messiah pointed 
it out.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(All that was left was to verify the 
result of the calculations... And that 
outcome is now in—)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Dance ideas just keep coming! There really 
are some amazing composers out there in 
the world!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I really, really couldn't be happier! 
Thank you so much, Shakur♪

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...No need for thanks. Now go dance to 
your heart's content.
